'''Vin Larel''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] serving in [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Larel was promoted and transferred from a line grunt to command of an outpost on an artic [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. While Larel initially thought the posting was a step up, the captain planned to request a transfer to a warmer assignment once their tour was up.<ref name="HS" />
